title: Warnings Against Folly

questions.question: Go to the ant, O what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:6 (ESV): "Go to the ant, O sluggard;"

questions.question: Consider her ways, and be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:6 (ESV): "consider her ways, and be wise."

questions.question: How many things does the Lord hate?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:16 (ESV): "There are six things that the Lord hates, seven that are an abomination to him:"

questions.question: Can a man carry fire next to his chest and his clothes not be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:27 (ESV): "Can a man carry fire next to his chest and his clothes not be burned?"

questions.question: He who commits adultery lacks what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:32 (ESV): "He who commits adultery lacks sense;"

questions.question: The ant prepares her bread in summer and gathers her food in what season?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:8 (ESV): "she prepares her bread in summer and gathers her food in harvest."

questions.question: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:10 (ESV): "a little folding of the hands to rest,"

questions.question: Poverty will come upon you like a robber, and want like an what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:11 (ESV): "and want like an armed man."

questions.question: For the commandment is a lamp and the teaching a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:23 (ESV): "For the commandment is a lamp and the teaching a light,"

questions.question: Jealousy makes a man furious, and he will not spare when he takes what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:34 (ESV): "and he will not spare when he takes revenge."

questions.question: If you are snared in the words of your mouth, caught in the words of your mouth, do this: deliver yourself, for you have come into the hand of your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:3 (ESV): "for you have come into the hand of your neighbor:"

questions.question: Which of these is NOT listed as something the Lord hates in Proverbs 6?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:17-19 lists haughty eyes, lying tongue, hands shedding innocent blood, etc. Lazy hand is not in this specific list.

questions.question: For the price of a prostitute is only a loaf of bread, but a married woman hunts down a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:26 (ESV): "but a married woman hunts down a precious life."

questions.question: Men do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy his appetite when he is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:30 (ESV): "if he steals to satisfy his appetite when he is hungry."

questions.question: He who does it destroys whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:32 (ESV): "he who does it destroys himself."

key_verse_text: Go to the ant, O sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise.
